questions.question: What's the actual difference between a review display widget (Yotpo/Okendo/Judge.me) and a review mining/analytics tool?
questions.answer_summary: Display widgets (Yotpo, Okendo, Judge.me) collect and show reviews on-site to build trust and conversion; review mining tools (Thematic, Chattermill, Appbot) instead process review text with NLP to extract sentiment and recurring themes for product/marketing insight — collection vs. analysis are genuinely different jobs.

questions.question: Which is cheaper for a small Shopify store: Judge.me, Okendo, or Yotpo?
questions.answer_summary: Okendo pricing starts near $20/month and Yotpo's paid plans start around $29/month scaling to $499+; multiple migrating users report Judge.me as notably cheaper than both for comparable features.

questions.question: Why do merchants report switching from Yotpo or Okendo to Judge.me?
questions.answer_summary: Users cited in comparison round-ups describe Judge.me as having a more modern interface, easier setup, better support, and lower cost versus Yotpo, and 'equivalent features at a fraction of the price' versus Okendo.

questions.question: Can review display platforms do sentiment analysis themselves, or do I need a separate tool?
questions.answer_summary: Standard review widgets are built for collection/display; dedicated sentiment/theme-extraction is the domain of separate tools like Chattermill, Thematic, and Lexalytics, which apply NLP to classify sentiment and surface causal themes.

questions.question: How do I analyze thousands of customer reviews without reading them manually?
questions.answer_summary: Guidance recommends centralizing reviews across channels, then using an AI/NLP tool to categorize themes and sentiment automatically since manual reading doesn't scale and introduces bias.

questions.question: What is 'review mining' and how is it used in ecommerce copywriting?
questions.answer_summary: Review mining means systematically reading reviews across sources to identify the language and purchase motivations customers use, then reusing that language in product copy.

questions.question: Do reviews and UGC actually move conversion rate, or is it overstated?
questions.answer_summary: A cited industry report found displaying product reviews boosted conversion by 58% in the study referenced, though other sources caution reviews need enough volume per product to move the needle meaningfully.

questions.question: Is Okendo or Yotpo the better fit for a Shopify-only brand vs. a multi-platform brand?
questions.answer_summary: Comparison guides frame Okendo as the stronger fit for Shopify-only stores wanting attribute-rich review forms at lower cost, and Yotpo as better when a brand needs multi-platform reach or a bundled marketing suite.

questions.question: Can tools like Appbot analyze reviews outside of app stores, e.g. ecommerce product reviews?
questions.answer_summary: Appbot is built primarily for app-store review aggregation (Apple/Google/Amazon/Microsoft) and theme extraction, illustrating the broader category of review-mining tools that ecommerce-specific vendors like Chattermill/Thematic adapt for product reviews.

questions.question: What's the difference between sentiment analysis and opinion mining for customer feedback?
questions.answer_summary: Sentiment analysis assigns an overall tone (positive/negative/neutral); opinion mining goes further to connect that tone to the specific product attribute or issue that caused it.

questions.question: Do review widgets help SEO through structured data/review schema?
questions.answer_summary: Review widget vendors note many platforms add Review schema markup to qualify pages for rich snippet results in search, a benefit separate from any analytics capability.

questions.question: How does combining quantitative (CSAT) and qualitative (open-text) review analysis work in practice?
questions.answer_summary: Guidance suggests using a quantitative score to flag where a problem exists, then using open-text/theme analysis to understand exactly what customers are describing.
